facts.business: Mangalam Cement Limited manufactures grey cement with a total capacity of 5.60 MTPA, operates captive thermal power plants (35 MW), waste heat recovery plant (11 MW), and wind turbines (13.65 MW).

capacity_or_capex.item: Additional cement grinding capacity of 1.20 MTPA at Aligarh Unit
Total grey cement manufacturing capacity increased to 5.60 MTPA
Captive Thermal Power Plant capacity 35 MW (17.5x2)
Waste Heat Recovery Power Plant capacity 11 MW
Wind Turbines total capacity 13.65 MW (13 turbines)

key_risks: The Company has formulated a comprehensive Risk Management Policy to identify, assess, monitor and mitigate risks that may impact its business objectives. A detailed discussion on the principal risks and the corresponding mitigation strategies forms part of the Management Discussion and Analysis section.
facts.related_party_note: During the year under review, the Company did not enter into any Related Party Transaction that was material in terms of the Company's Policy on Materiality of Related Party Transactions or the provisions of Regulation 23 of the SEBI Listing Regulations. No contract or arrangement with related parties falling within the scope of Section 188(1) of the Companies Act, 2013 was entered into during the financial year that required disclosure in Form AOC-2. All Related Party Transactions are placed before the Audit Committee for prior approval.
